import.title: Start with your footage
import.body: Drag in video, audio or images. Long takes are fine; the mess gets cleaned up later.

say.title: Say what you want, in plain words
say.body: “Remove the pauses.” “Add captions.” “Zoom on the punchline.” The assistant edits the timeline directly, and one undo reverts anything.

auto.title: Or let it do the whole edit
auto.body: Pick the kind of video you are making, switch to Auto, and Vibed runs the full pass: cuts, captions, motion design, sound and a finish for the platform.
auto.locked: Pick the kind of video you are making, switch to Auto, and Vibed runs the full pass: cuts, captions, motion design, sound and a finish for the platform. Auto and editing styles come with Creator.

shorts.title: Get a week of posts out of one take
shorts.body: Shorts finds the moments that stand on their own and cuts each into its own vertical version, finished for TikTok, Reels or Shorts.
shorts.locked: Shorts finds the moments that stand on their own and cuts each into its own vertical version, finished for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. Available on Creator.

export.body: Render an MP4 and download your finished video. Choose the resolution and quality that fit your project.

first_upload.title: Now just ask
first_upload.body: Type what you want changed. “Cut the silences” is a good first thing to try.

first_clip.title: Your timeline
first_clip.body: Drag to move, drag an edge to trim. Every AI edit lands here too, and one undo takes it back.

first_ai_edit.title: Not what you meant?
first_ai_edit.body: One undo reverts the whole edit, however many clips it touched. Say it differently and run it again.

first_captions.title: Captions are editable text
first_captions.body: Fix a word here and the burned-in caption changes with it. No re-render needed to correct a name.

auto_available.title: Stop editing by hand
auto_available.body: Pick a style, switch to Auto, and the whole pass runs: cuts, captions, motion design and sound.
auto_available.locked: Pick a style and switch to Auto to run the whole pass at once: cuts, captions, motion design and sound. Comes with Creator.

shorts_ready.title: This one could be several posts
shorts_ready.body: Shorts pulls the strongest moments out of a long take and finishes each one vertically.
shorts_ready.locked: Shorts pulls the strongest moments out of a long take and finishes each one vertically. Available on Creator.

before_export.title: Before you export
before_export.body: Pro Finish adds the hook title, caption emphasis and sound design in one pass. Worth a click first.

panel_collapsed.title: The panel is tucked away
panel_collapsed.body: Your tools are still here. Click any icon to bring the panel back, or the same icon again to hide it.
